evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 法慧寺、宝相寺、谐奇趣
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海嶽開襟東北為諧竒趣東為法慧寺山門西嚮内為四面延樓後殿為光明性海其西别院有琉璃方塔法慧寺東為寳相寺山門南嚮内為澄光閣後為曇霏閣又後崇基上有殿為現大圓鏡（長春園册）臣等謹案法慧寺山門額曰普香界現大圓鏡殿内額曰香臺華鬘
evidence.summary: The only line in 日下舊聞考 on the European palaces: 諧竒趣 north-east of 海嶽開襟. Then 法慧寺 with a west-facing gate, 四面延樓, 光明性海 and a glazed square pagoda; 寳相寺 with a south-facing gate, 澄光閣, 曇霏閣 and 現大圓鏡 on a raised base.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 法慧寺
evidence.summary: Finished 1747 on the slope north of 海岳开襟. Gate 普香界 faces west; a five-bay main hall, a five-bay rear-facing tower with eleven-bay wings (the 四面延楼), a rear hall 光明性海, and in a west court the seven-tiered glazed pagoda, square below and round above, 23.55 m.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 四面延楼.
